purpose: Orientation and routing only; not an evidence substitute or execution authority.
rules: Every factual claim must link to a source or verified runtime observation.
Unknown and stale facts remain explicitly unknown/stale; never infer completion from a page visit or status snapshot.
This graph is intentionally lossy; consult linked canonical artifacts before modifying code or making operational claims.

nodes.label: Evidence-aware study and engineering of agentic systems
nodes.summary: Maintain a versioned research model of emergent agent behaviour and self-improving agent systems, with a tested supporting toolchain.

nodes.label: Canonical research graph
nodes.summary: Curated mechanism-level claims spanning model, harness, swarm, habitat, governance, and orchestration; tensions and counterevidence are retained.

nodes.label: Research and self-improving-harness toolchain
nodes.summary: Python tools implement graph validation, research loops, proposal/evidence flow, and tested orchestration primitives.

nodes.label: Runtime outputs are proposals, not canonical truth
nodes.summary: Traces and observations may inform proposals but must not silently rewrite stable graph knowledge.

nodes.label: Evidence, challenge, and retraction discipline
nodes.summary: Claims retain provenance and uncertainty; counterclaims are preserved; promotion requires review and verifiable evidence.

nodes.label: Live operations and watchdogs
nodes.summary: Cron/watchdog, queue, and service state are dynamic and must be refreshed from their live source before action.

nodes.label: Google connection is gated and currently incomplete
nodes.summary: Personal Data Portability requires user OAuth, test-user approval, exact scopes, and a successful API call; Drive upload needs valid write authorization.

nodes.label: Safe agent collaboration
nodes.summary: Use task branches, inspect staged diffs, run validators/tests, avoid secrets/raw traces, and document proof and unresolved blockers.
